title: Eric Carlisle Design System Inventory
description: Machine-readable inventory of reusable design-system patterns implemented across ericcarlisle.com. This is a personal blog site, not a published component library. The inventory documents patterns that exist in the codebase for agent-assisted development.

patterns.name: Header
patterns.purpose: Fixed top navigation with site title, primary page links, search icon, theme toggle, and social links.
patterns.whenToUse: Every page uses this component via BlogPost layout. It is the primary site navigation.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not duplicate. Do not embed inside other navigational elements.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Uses aria-expanded on menu toggle, aria-label on search link, aria-current="page" on active nav links. Mobile menu collapses at 840px breakpoint. Scroll-down hides header via translateY(-100%).

patterns.name: HeaderLink
patterns.purpose: Navigation link with automatic active-state detection based on current URL pathname.
patterns.whenToUse: Inside Header for any primary navigation link.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for external links, footer links, or tag links.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Sets aria-current="page" when the href matches the current URL path. Active state shows a bottom border in brand color and bold weight.

patterns.name: Footer
patterns.purpose: Site footer with copyright line and social icon links.
patterns.whenToUse: Every page uses this via BlogPost layout.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not duplicate. Footer is rendered once per page at the bottom.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Contains a semantic <footer> element. Social links inside a <nav aria-label="Social links">.

patterns.name: Card
patterns.purpose: Content card with optional image, title as link, body slot, meta information, and tags. Supports a featured variant with larger title when first child in a grid--featured-first container.
patterns.whenToUse: Blog post listings, portfolio entries, any content preview that needs a visual card container.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for navigation items, form elements, or standalone images without text content.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Card uses a ::after pseudo-element on the title link to make the entire card clickable while keeping tag links separately interactive. Hover effect (translateY and shadow) only applies when prefers-reduced-motion is no-preference.

patterns.name: PostGrid
patterns.purpose: Renders a list of blog post entries as Card components in a responsive grid, with optional featured-first layout for the most recent post.
patterns.whenToUse: Blog index page, tag filter pages, any page that lists multiple blog posts.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for non-blog listings. Use individual Card components in custom grids for other content types.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Renders as a semantic <ul> with each Card as <li>. Supports animation-delay staggered entry via inline style.

patterns.name: Button
patterns.purpose: Primary action button with solid background and outline variant. Used for CTAs across the site.
patterns.whenToUse: Form submissions, primary calls-to-action, navigation to key pages (portfolio, blog).
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for inline links, tag links, or non-action navigation. Use HeaderLink or standard <a> for regular page links.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Minimum touch target 44px via --size-touch-target-min. Focus-visible outline uses brand primary. Hover lift (translateY) only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

patterns.name: SocialLinks
patterns.purpose: Icon links to GitHub, LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon profiles.
patterns.whenToUse: Used in Header and Footer. Can also be embedded in About or Contact pages.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for sharing URLs (see ShareStrip). Do not add social networks not yet supported.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Each link has visually-hidden descriptive text via .sr-only class and aria-hidden="true" on SVG icons. Minimum 44px touch targets.

patterns.name: ThemeToggle
patterns.purpose: Button that switches between dark and light themes, persisting preference in localStorage.
patterns.whenToUse: Used in Header. Could be placed in any persistent UI location.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Only one instance per page. Do not render multiple toggles.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: aria-label="Toggle light/dark theme". Sun icon shown in dark mode, moon in light. Theme preference is applied before first paint via inline script in BaseHead.

patterns.name: ShareStrip
patterns.purpose: Social sharing links for X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Mastodon, and Bluesky. Appears in the article sidebar.
patterns.whenToUse: Article pages, optionally on other content pages via the `share` prop.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use on non-content pages (homepage, contact, search).
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Each share link has an aria-label describing the target platform. SVG icons are aria-hidden="true". 44px touch targets.

patterns.name: TagFilterBar
patterns.purpose: Displays tag links either as a filter bar (when passed tagData for the full tag index) or as post tags (when passed a tags array for the current article).
patterns.whenToUse: Blog index page for filtering by tag, article pages for displaying post tags.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for navigation links outside the blog context.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Uses role="group" with aria-label describing context (Filter posts by tag / Post tags). Focus-visible outlines use dashed style.

patterns.name: PaginationNav
patterns.purpose: Two-column grid navigation for previous/next posts or pages.
patterns.whenToUse: Article pages for prev/next post navigation. Could be adapted for paginated listings.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for primary navigation or tag filtering.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Uses <nav aria-label="Pagination">. Previous link uses rel="prev", next link uses rel="next". The next link is right-aligned via .post-nav-next.

patterns.name: FormattedDate
patterns.purpose: Renders a date in long-format locale string (e.g. June 15, 2024) inside a semantic <time> element with ISO datetime attribute.
patterns.whenToUse: Anywhere a human-readable date is displayed: article headers, card meta, blog listings.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for machine timestamps or relative time strings.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Uses semantic <time> with datetime attribute for machine parsing.

patterns.name: Webmentions
patterns.purpose: Displays social webmentions: likes, reposts, and reply comments from the webmention.io service.
patterns.whenToUse: Article pages below the content, after pagination nav.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Only on article pages. Not applicable to static pages (about, contact, portfolio).
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Avatar images use alt="" (decorative). Author names are linked with descriptive aria-labels (e.g. Liked by Author Name). Reply articles use semantic <article> elements.

patterns.name: ModelResourceLinks
patterns.purpose: List of 3D printing model resource links (Printables, Thingiverse, Tinkercad) with branded SVG icons.
patterns.whenToUse: 3D printing blog posts that reference downloadable or editable models.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for non-3D-printing content. The icons are specifically branded for these three services.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: SVG icons have aria-hidden="true" and focusable="false". Links have descriptive visible text.

patterns.name: BaseHead
patterns.purpose: Centralized HTML <head> metadata assembly including charset, viewport, favicons, canonical URL, Open Graph, Twitter cards, JSON-LD structured data via SchemaOrg, RSS/webmention links, and Google Analytics via Partytown.
patterns.whenToUse: Every page through BlogPost layout. Do not bypass.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not duplicate. BaseHead is included once per page by the layout.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Sets viewport, language, and character encoding. Inline theme-preference script prevents flash of unstyled content.

patterns.name: SchemaOrg
patterns.purpose: Generates JSON-LD structured data for multiple page types: homepage (CollectionPage), article (BlogPosting with breadcrumb), about (ProfilePage), contact (ContactPage), portfolio (CollectionPage), search (SearchResultsPage), collections (CollectionPage with ItemList).
patterns.whenToUse: Every page via BaseHead. The pageType prop determines the schema emitted.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not call directly unless building a custom page outside the BlogPost layout.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Data is invisible to visual users but enables rich search results and agent consumption.

patterns.name: BlogPost
patterns.purpose: Primary page layout used by every page on the site. Includes BaseHead, Header, main content area with prose typography, optional sidebar (article only with TOC and ShareStrip), article features (reading progress bar, hero image, pagination, webmentions), and Footer.
patterns.whenToUse: Every page. This is the single site layout.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not create alternate layouts. Feature gates use the pageType prop.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Includes skip-link to main content. Main element has tabindex="-1" for skip-link focus. Article pages have reading-progress bar with progressbar role.

patterns.name: Tag / Chip
patterns.purpose: Pill-shaped label elements. Tag is interactive (link, hover effect). Chip is static (same visual, no interaction).
patterns.whenToUse: Tags for blog post metadata, category labels, and skill/area-of-focus chips on the homepage hero.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for navigation links or buttons. Tags are metadata labels only.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Tags are <a> elements with href. Chips are <span> elements with no interaction. Both use --font-mono for consistent code-style appearance.

patterns.name: Callout
patterns.purpose: Highlighted informational block with a thick left border in brand primary color.
patterns.whenToUse: Development warnings (e.g. Turnstile key not configured), important notes within content, warnings that need visual emphasis.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for success messages (use success card pattern instead) or regular prose content.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Uses standard color contrast. Strong text inside callout uses --text-primary for emphasis.

patterns.name: TOC Sidebar
patterns.purpose: Sticky table of contents in the article sidebar that auto-generates from h2/h3 headings and highlights the active section on scroll.
patterns.whenToUse: Article pages automatically. The TOC appears in the right sidebar on article pages.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Only applicable to article pages. Automatically hidden if no h2/h3 headings are found.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Rendered inside <nav aria-label="Table of contents">. Active heading is tracked via scroll listener and marked with CSS class.

patterns.name: Stats Grid
patterns.purpose: Four-column grid of stat cards showing numeric values with labels.
patterns.whenToUse: Portfolio or about pages to display key metrics. Currently used on the design-system reference page.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for interactive content or navigation.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Values and labels are semantic HTML elements. Responsive: collapses to 2 columns at 720px.

patterns.name: Reading Progress Bar
patterns.purpose: Fixed-position progress bar at the top of the viewport that fills as the user scrolls through an article.
patterns.whenToUse: Article pages via BlogPost layout.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Only on article pages. Not applicable to static pages.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Uses role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax. Updates on scroll/resize with passive event listeners.

patterns.name: Skip Link
patterns.purpose: Keyboard-only link that appears on focus to skip directly to main content.
patterns.whenToUse: Every page via global.css and the skip-link HTML in BlogPost layout.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not remove. This is a required accessibility feature.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Positioned off-screen (top: -100%) by default, slides into view on focus. High z-index (9999) to overlay all content. Visible focus border in --color-focus.

patterns.name: Contact Form
patterns.purpose: Contact form with name, email, subject, message fields, honeypot anti-spam, Cloudflare Turnstile verification, and success card on submission.
patterns.whenToUse: Contact page.
patterns.whenNotToUse: This is a page-specific form. Do not reuse in other contexts.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: All inputs have semantic <label> elements. Required inputs have required attribute. Honeypot is visually hidden with position:absolute. Error messages use role="alert" and are initially hidden. Success card receives focus on submission.

patterns.name: Prose
patterns.purpose: Content typography system for article body text, including paragraph measure, heading spacing, list styles, link colors, and inline semantics.
patterns.whenToUse: Applied via .prose class to article content areas. Automatically used by BlogPost layout for the <slot /> content.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not apply to navigation, cards, or UI components.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Paragraphs and list items limited to 68ch max-width for readability. Headings use scroll-margin-top to account for fixed header. Link colors use brand-primary with hover transition.

patterns.name: Code Block
patterns.purpose: Inline code and pre-formatted code block styling, supplemented by astro-expressive-code for syntax-highlighted blocks.
patterns.whenToUse: Any technical content that includes code snippets.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not apply to non-code text elements.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Inline code uses --font-mono with --bg-surface background. Pre blocks use semantic <pre> element with border and overflow-x: auto for horizontal scrolling.

patterns.name: Blockquote
patterns.purpose: Pull quote styling with left border accent and slightly enlarged text.
patterns.whenToUse: Article content for emphasized quotes or pull quotes.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for regular paragraph text or informational callouts (use Callout pattern).
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Semantic <blockquote> element. Left border uses --color-link for visual emphasis.

patterns.name: Card Grid
patterns.purpose: Responsive auto-fill grid for Card components. Supports featured-first layout where the first child spans full width with an enlarged title.
patterns.whenToUse: Blog listing pages, portfolio listings, any multi-card layout.
patterns.whenNotToUse: Do not use for single-card layouts or non-card content.
patterns.accessibilityNotes: Grid is purely visual layout. Semantic structure comes from child elements. Responsive: single column at 720px.
